Test fixtures. Regenerate the synthetic ones with `python -m tests.make_fixtures` (macOS for the audio).
Media is git-ignored; only this README and `transcripts.json` are committed.

Recorded by Kevin for `--live` runs (optional, put them in `real/`):
- `real/chair_walk.mp4`: walking toward a real chair at eye height (else `zoom_walk/` is used)
- `real/crosswalk_walk.jpg`, `real/crosswalk_dont_walk.jpg`, `real/crosswalk_countdown.jpg`
- `real/room.jpg`, `real/keys_on_table.jpg`
- `real/audio/*.wav`: the demo phrases spoken into the glasses or phone mic
